name: supply_chain_list_po_placement_candidates
description:
List items needing PO placement based on lead time + safety stock + PO cadence coverage.

IMPORTANT — flat input: pass all parameters at top level. Do NOT use nested query/filters/tool_specific wrappers.

Required: company_id (integer). Calls without company_id are rejected by schema.

VELOCITY MODES (sales_velocity, default: 'planned'):
  • 'planned': Averages forecast units over the coverage window (lead_time + safety_stock months) starting at the arrival month — forward-looking, accounts for seasonal demand during lead time, matches the 60.0 Inventory Planning QuickSight analysis.
  • 'current': Uses trailing 30-day realized average — backward-looking.
  • 'target': Uses daily_unit_sales_target from sales plan — goal-based.

Why 'planned' may differ from 30-day average:
  The tool averages FORECAST velocity over the coverage window anchored at the arrival month to prevent under-ordering before high-demand periods, while smoothing single-month forecast noise.
  Example: 60-day lead time + 60-day safety stock → arrival in month 3, window = 4 months → velocity = sum(months 3-6 forecast) / (4 × 30.41), even if trailing 30d differs.

Inventory calculation:
  available = warehouse balances + FBA available + WIP orders (if include_work_in_progress=true). WIP covers every order in progress; total_ordered_quantity is not added separately (it overlaps WIP).
  WIP orders are POs with status 'Created'/pending not yet received. Including WIP (default) prevents double-ordering.
  recommended_order_units respects the supplier MOQ: positive quantities below MOQ are bumped up to MOQ (moq is returned per item). The MOQ excess appears in WIP after ordering, so subsequent recommendations self-adjust.
  Effective safety stock = safety_stock_days x ss_multiplier (revenue-class A/B/C/D multiplier from company settings). Items with missing lead_time_days/safety_stock_days use 90/60-day defaults - lead_time_days_source and safety_stock_days_source report 'item', 'default_90'/'default_60', or 'override'. ALWAYS tell the user when a default was used so they can configure real values in NeonPanel.

planning_base (auto-defaulted if omitted):
  • Omit it — the tool picks automatically based on selector fields and sales_velocity.
  • If target_skus/target_asins/parent_asins are set → 'targeted_only'.
  • If sales_velocity='planned' → 'planned_only'; 'target' → 'targeted_only'; 'current' → 'actively_sold_only'.
  • Set explicitly only when you need to override (e.g., 'all' to include zero-velocity items).

company_id: pass directly (integer). Do NOT pass a freeform company name — use account_list_companies first to find the numeric id.

planning_base.description: Which items to include in planning. Auto-defaulted if omitted — see tool description.

target_skus.description: Filter to specific SKUs (sets planning_base='targeted_only' automatically).

marketplaces.description: Marketplace filter. Values: US, UK, ALL. Default: ALL.

revenue_abcd_class.description: Filter by revenue class (A=top 20%, B=next 30%, C=next 30%, D=tail 20%).

sales_velocity.description: Velocity calculation mode. See tool description for details.

lead_time_days_override.description: Lead time in days for PO arrival estimate.

safety_stock_days_override.description: Target safety stock buffer in days.

include_work_in_progress.description: Include WIP purchase orders (status 'Created'/pending) in available inventory. Default true prevents double-ordering. Set false for conservative planning.
